Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Microphone, A Beaming Smile On His Face.

JASPER
Thank You, Thank You. I Am Truly Honored To Receive This Record.

The Crowd Erupts In Cheers And Applause As Jasper Accepts The Plaque.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Our Universe Is A Multiverse, And That Every Time A Decision Is Made, The Universe Branches Off Into Infinite Parallel Universes.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, His Words Spilling Out In A Rush.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just Living In A Different Universe? What If I've Been Alive For 127 Years, But I'm Just A Branch Off The Main Tree?

Jasper's Voice Cracks, His Emotions Overwhelming Him.

JASPER (V.O)
Oh God, Oh God, Oh God... What If I'm Just A Simulation? A Program Created By Some Advanced Being? What If I'm Just A Character In A Game?

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake, His Eyes Wide With Fear.

JASPER (V.O)
I Don't Want To Die! I Don't Want To Leave This Universe! I Want To Keep Living, Keep Experiencing, Keep Being!

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Mind Reeling With The Implications.

JASPER (V.O)
I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone In This Universe. I'm Not Alone In The Multiverse.

Jasper's Body Goes limp, His Eyes Frozen On The Ceiling. The Camera Zooms In On His Face, His Expression A Mix Of Terror And Desperation.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
